plugin.name: Manga
plugin.description: Local CBZ metadata, covers and AniList matching for manga.

versions.changelog: Optional native series detail: large cover, AniList synopsis and authors, with book volume cards below. Enable Group series folders and Series detail page, then scan. Numeric volume ordering survives metadata refresh. Verified on Jellyfin 10.11.6 including CBZ reader. Conversion reindexes existing folders; save important manual metadata first. Native collections may write collection.xml and folder.jpg beside CBZ files.
